name: Mitra Samal

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Mitra Samal is a Bhubaneswar-based poet and writer with a background in software consulting. Her work includes poetry, stories and literary interviews, and her collections include ‘Beginning’ and ‘Silence Has a Sound’. Her poems and prose have appeared in journals including Muse India, Madras Courier, Borderless and The Chakkar.

Her Kabita Live poems bring together public freedom and the comforts of everyday life. ‘Remember Freedom’ insists on the right to speak, love and live without fear, using a recurring phrase to keep that possibility alive. ‘Silent Streets’ listens to children, evening prayers and faint bells: its quiet is inhabited, a shared refuge rather than an empty place.
